rationale:
Issue #1415 reports that tall style discards the blank line between a leading line comment (e.g. the copyright header) and the following code, giving the two concrete examples '// Comment.

main() {}' and a copyright block followed by an import. The fixing commit 0c3e4fc states preservation was already working generally and only the blank after the *first* top-level comment was dropped, so at buggy revision bdc8a8c the formatter behaved inconsistently with its own already-shipped blank-line handling; that is a pre-existing behavioral defect, not a new capability. The minimized production patch keeps exactly one behavioral hunk in lib/src/front_end/sequence_builder.dart, setting _allowBlank when the preceding comments are non-empty before calling addBlank(); the doc-comment-only hunk from the original commit was dropped during minimization, and the only other file is benchmark/case/large.expect, whose single added blank line is the mechanical expectation update caused by the same output change. No refactor, feature extension, config-only, or unrelated edit is present, and _allowBlank/addBlank already existed at the parent revision, so no new production API is introduced. The triggers are unmodified upstream fixtures from the same commit: tall/regression/1400/1415.unit reproduces the issue's two examples verbatim, and tall/top_level/comment.unit adds leading-comment/declaration and directive cases for the same behavior; both are declared reproduced by the strict gates. Strict evidence (original and post-minimization) reports build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers and full_suite.fixed_all_green all passing with 3 repetitions and no failed checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#1415 is the single allowed verified issue key, so the root cause is not a registry duplicate.

Issue #1415 reports that tall style discards the blank line between a leading line comment (e.g. a copyright header) and the following declaration, showing exactly the '// Comment.

main() {}' and copyright-then-import examples. The minimized production change is a single behavioral edit in SequenceBuilder.addCommentsBefore: when a blank is required before the next token and comments were just emitted, it sets _allowBlank = true before addBlank(), which restores blank-line preservation after a leading comment. The commit/PR text scopes this to an edge case in already-shipped blank-preservation behavior (only the first top-level comment lost its blank), i.e. inconsistent existing behavior rather than a new capability; the buggy revision's passing of the newly added block_comment.stmt case corroborates that general preservation already worked. The upstream fixture trigger test/tall/regression/1400/1415.unit reproduces the issue's two examples verbatim and is data-driven through the pre-existing test/tall_format_test.dart harness, so it uses no API introduced by the fix. Strict evidence (both original and post-minimization) shows build passing on both revisions, isolated buggy differential failure on tall/regression/1400/1415.unit and tall/top_level/comment.unit, fixed-clean and reversed runs green, deterministic fingerprints across 3 repetitions, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced triggers. The minimized patch drops the doc-comment-only hunk from the original commit and retains only the behavioral hunk plus the benchmark/case/large.expect expectation line that is a direct consequence of the same output change; no refactor, feature flag, option, or config edit is present. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#1415 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so no duplicate root cause.
